dialogue.chat: Conversation with me? Wise choice. People pay for this in some villages, %1$s.
dialogue.chat/1: An excellent choice, talking to me. The most interesting company you'll keep today.
dialogue.chat/2: I've always time for someone with taste this good, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations: You've come to the right person, %1$s. Ask away — I give excellent answers.
dialogue.conversations/1: You chose your company well today. Go on — I don't rattle easy.
dialogue.conversations/2: Speak up. I've an answer for most things and a fine bluff for the rest.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Splendidly, of course. The bread rose, the fence held, and the week went precisely as I intended.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Magnificent. I usually am — it's a discipline, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Better than most, worse than I'll be tomorrow. I improve on schedule.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: A difficult stretch. Not a defeat — a delay. Though I'll admit, %1$s, your asking helps the schedule.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: A hard patch. Even I get them — I simply get through them louder.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: Asked and answered, %1$s. My good mood needs no encore.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice? I'm flattered. Still standing tall, still your favorite.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Exactly as planned. Cold well water, short line at the smith, sun on time. The day knows better than to cross me.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Three decisions before noon, all correct. A typical morning.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The day is misbehaving. It will come around by supper. They always do when I'm involved.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Rough edges. Nothing I can't file smooth by dusk. Watch me.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: Naturally. I'm the best at it for three villages in any direction, and that is a simple statement of fact.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: Love it — there's nothing like being very good at a thing and knowing it.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Between us — the work is beneath me. I do it flawlessly anyway. Standards are standards.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: The easy days waste me. Bring a real challenge and see what I do with it.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s is fortunate to have me. I like to think I raise the average considerably.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: %2$s knows me and I know %2$s. Ask anyone — they'll point you my way, smiling.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: They adore me, mostly. The holdouts are simply jealous, which is its own kind of praise.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Good people. Half come to ME for advice — which I give freely and, naturally, correctly.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: The finest the inn offers. They save the best cut for me; reputation has its perks.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Whatever's boldest on the board. I've a strong palate, like everything else about me.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: A fine story, saved for the right audience. It begins with a stubborn child who was right about nearly everything.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: I never once doubted I'd amount to something. I was right. I usually am.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: I don't dream, %1$s — I plan. And the plan is a house on the hill everyone said couldn't be built. Watch me.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: My name outlasting the wall and the well both. Grand? Yes. Beyond me? Never.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: You'll keep this quiet. I fear being ordinary. Waking up one morning as just another face at the well.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Being seen to fall. I hide it well — that's rather the point, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: I have excellent taste, %1$s, and I've decided you're worth keeping around. Take that as the honor it is.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: You don't fawn, and that's exactly why I can't stop looking your way.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: That answer is reserved for my inner circle. Small circle. Excellent view. Earn your seat.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: I'm an open book about my triumphs. The rest has a cover charge. Keep visiting.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Even I don't hand that answer to just anyone, %1$s. Prove yourself first. I suspect you will.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: That one stays locked till you've earned the key. You're close.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing worth my attention this week. When something happens, I'll know it first. I always do.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Quiet week. Give it time — the interesting things happen where I'm standing.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happiest I've been — and I don't hand out superlatives. You did that, %1$s. Well done.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: I chose you over everyone and I never second-guess. Best decision I ever made.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: Called it months ago — %2$s and %3$s are married. I'm never wrong about these things, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: %2$s and %3$s wed at last. A fine match, and yes, I predicted it. I usually do.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: %2$s and %3$s have split. Saw that coming a mile off — some pairings simply lack my staying power.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: So %2$s and %3$s are done. Pity. Not everyone has the sense to hold onto a good thing, as I do.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: Grim news, %1$s. %2$s is gone. A real loss — and I don't say that of many. The village is smaller for it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: We've lost %2$s. Even I've no clever line for that. Good soul. They'll be missed, and that's the truth.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s was born this week — and mark my words, that child's going places. I've an eye for these things.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: A new arrival: little %2$s. Healthy, strong, destined for something. You heard it here first.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: %2$s has moved into the village. Smart of them, really — best address in three villages, now that I'm in it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: New neighbor, %2$s. I'll introduce myself properly. They'll be glad to know me — they always are.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: %2$s has left for good. Their loss, frankly — but I wish them well out there.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: Heard %2$s moved on. The village dims a shade without them. Still, we'll manage. We always do.
